known_caveats: Plot detections support occurrence at sampled locations. Missing detections are source silence only and never countywide absence or survey non-detection.
Complete source silence changes research status only and never establishes absence or non-detection.
Underlying observation freshness has no one source-wide date.
source_warnings: FIA source silence never creates verified absence or survey non-detection.
deviations: The national FIA delivery was acquired once and partitioned locally without state-specific network requests.
Only exact state-listed symbol, dictionary, catalog, and active county matches may publish.
Coordinates and automatic retired-geography crosswalks were not used.
